User Guide
"Quiz Alarm Clock Application User Guide

" "1.🏠 Home Screen
" "When you open the app, you'll see the Bottom Navigation bar with 3 icons:
" "- 🕒 Home: List of set alarms
" "- ➕ Add Alarm: Create a new alarm
" "- 📊 History: View quiz answer history when dismissing alarms

" "2.🔧 Settings
" "In the settings screen, you can:
" "- 📤 Share Data: Export quiz or history data
" "- ♻️ Reset Data: Delete all application data
" "Theme and Language:
" "- Theme: Switch between Light / Dark interface
" "- Languages:
" " · Vietnamese
" " · English
" " · Korean

" "3.➕ Create New Alarm
" "Press the ➕ button on the bottom bar to enter the Modify Alarm interface, including:
" "- ⏰ Time Picker: Select hour and minute
" "- 🔁 Loop: Choose alarm repetition: Once / Daily
" "- 🎵 Music: Select ringtone
" "- 📳 Vibration: Toggle vibration on/off for alarms
" "- 🗑️ Delete after: Automatically delete after the alarm rings
" "- 📝 Note: Add custom notes
" "- ❌ Delete Button: Delete this alarm

" "4.📚 Configure Quiz for Alarm
" "After pressing "Next" in the Modify Alarm interface, you can select the quiz content:
" "- Subject: Math / English
" "- Topic based on subject
" "- Difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Nightmare
" "- Number of questions: Optional

" "5.🔔 When the Alarm Rings
" "- A notification will appear in the status bar.
" "- Tap the notification → navigate to the quiz solving interface.
" "- "Do Quiz Now" button to confirm solving the puzzle to turn off the alarm

" "6.❓ Quiz Interface When Alarm Rings
" "- Displays the question and 4 choices A/B/C/D.
" "- "Do Quiz Now" button to confirm completion.
" "Rules:
" "- ✅ If you answer at least 50% question correctly → Alarm can be turned off.
" "- ❌ If all answers are wrong → Must retake the quiz from the beginning!

" "7.📊 Quiz Answer History Interface
" "- View history of attempts, results with answers.

" "Conclusion:
" "The application helps you:
" "- Wake up on time
" "- Stay alert by exercising your brain
" "- Learn and train your morning reflexes!"
